dialogues.jp:
自分の気持ちに素直になれ、ことりはそう言っ
た。
dialogues.en: Be honest with your feelings, she said.
dialogues.text: Be honest with your feelings, she said.

dialogues.jp:
今日だって、俺の方をみて小さくガッツポーズ
なんかしたりして……。
dialogues.en: And Kotori reminded me of it earlier today, winking at me.
dialogues.text: And Kotori reminded me of it earlier today, winking at me.

dialogues.jp: 俺は窓の外の四角い空を眺めた。
dialogues.en: I stared at the sky through the window.
dialogues.text: I stared at the sky through the window.

dialogues.jp: （応援してくれてるのはわかるんだけどな）
dialogues.en: "(I know you'd support it, but...)"
dialogues.text: "(I know you'd support it, but...)"

dialogues.en: "...Haah."
dialogues.text: "...Haah."

dialogues.jp: 自然とため息が漏れる。
dialogues.en: I sighed, practically out of habit.
dialogues.text: I sighed, practically out of habit.

dialogues.jp:
そうは言っても、やはり認めたくないと思って
いる自分はいるわけで、
dialogues.en: Even if you say that, until I accept it myself...
dialogues.text: Even if you say that, until I accept it myself...

dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、今日も空が青いな………………」
dialogues.en: "...Ahh, the sky is so blue today..."
dialogues.text: "...Ahh, the sky is so blue today..."

dialogues.jp: いったりきたり、いったりきたり……。
dialogues.en: Round and round and round and round...
dialogues.text: Round and round and round and round...

dialogues.jp:
昼飯を一人隠れるようにして食った後、俺は中
庭をあてもなくぐるぐると周回運動していた。
dialogues.en:
Hiding away alone during lunch, I paced around the
courtyard.
dialogues.text:
Hiding away alone during lunch, I paced around the
courtyard.

dialogues.jp:
通りかかる学生たちが、そんな俺の『動物園熊
的行動』に奇異の目を向けてくる。
dialogues.en:
The students passing by stared at me as if I was some zoo
animal on display.
dialogues.text:
The students passing by stared at me as if I was some zoo
animal on display.

dialogues.jp: ……あああ、もう。
dialogues.en: ...Ahhh, whatever.
dialogues.text: ...Ahhh, whatever.

dialogues.jp: どさっと中庭のベンチに腰を降ろす。
dialogues.en: Tired of walking, I sat down on one of the benches.
dialogues.text: Tired of walking, I sat down on one of the benches.

dialogues.jp: 今、教室に戻れば工藤やことりに会ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
If I go back to class now, I might bump into Kudou or
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
If I go back to class now, I might bump into Kudou or
Kotori.

dialogues.jp: それがなんだかとても怖かった。
dialogues.en: Not something I had the guts to do.
dialogues.text: Not something I had the guts to do.

dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp: 何度目になるかわからない溜息をつく。
dialogues.en: I let out another of my inumerable sighs.
dialogues.text: I let out another of my inumerable sighs.

dialogues.jp:
このままここで、誰にも会わずに一日が過ぎれ
ばいいのに……。
dialogues.en:
If I could just stay here the whole day, and avoid contact
with them...
dialogues.text:
If I could just stay here the whole day, and avoid contact
with them...

dialogues.jp: 「そうも言ってられんしなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "But that's easy to say..."
dialogues.text: "But that's easy to say..."

dialogues.jp:
……いい加減で戻らないと、午後の授業が始まっ
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
...If I don't start heading back now, I'd be late for
afternoon classes.
dialogues.text:
...If I don't start heading back now, I'd be late for
afternoon classes.

dialogues.jp: 仕方なくのろのろと教室に向かった。
dialogues.en: Left with no choice, I slowly starte walking back.
dialogues.text: Left with no choice, I slowly starte walking back.

dialogues.jp:
もしこの気持ちを告白したら、工藤はどう思う
だろう。
dialogues.en: I wonder what Kudou would think if I confessed.
dialogues.text: I wonder what Kudou would think if I confessed.

dialogues.jp:
常識的に考えて、好意的な反応が返ってくると
は思えなかった。
dialogues.en: Most probably, he won't react very well.
dialogues.text: Most probably, he won't react very well.

dialogues.jp:
前の告白の仕返しに、俺がからかってると思う
かもしれない。
dialogues.en:
He might even think I'd be getting back at him for his fake
confession the time before.
dialogues.text:
He might even think I'd be getting back at him for his fake
confession the time before.

dialogues.jp: それだけならまだ良かった。
dialogues.en: That's not all either.
dialogues.text: That's not all either.

dialogues.jp:
友達にすら戻れなくなってしまうかもしれない
のだ。
dialogues.en:
If I don't put it well, I may regret it for the rest of my
life.
dialogues.text:
If I don't put it well, I may regret it for the rest of my
life.

dialogues.jp: ドドドドドド……………………。
dialogues.en:
There'd be no way we'd be able to go back to just being
friends if I confess as well.
dialogues.text:
There'd be no way we'd be able to go back to just being
friends if I confess as well.

dialogues.en:
And if that starts becoming gossip, about where Kudou and I
stand...
dialogues.text:
And if that starts becoming gossip, about where Kudou and I
stand...

dialogues.jp:
あれっと思う間もなく地響きはどんどん近づい
てくる。
dialogues.en: Oh boy oh boy oh boy......
dialogues.text: Oh boy oh boy oh boy......

dialogues.jp: ばょいーんんんん！！！
dialogues.en:
As my brain filled with useless little thoughts, my ear
detected a tremor coming from the ground.
dialogues.text:
As my brain filled with useless little thoughts, my ear
detected a tremor coming from the ground.

dialogues.jp: 「ぉわあぁぁッ」
dialogues.en: "...What's that?"
dialogues.text: "...What's that?"

dialogues.jp:
その直後、廊下を猛ダッシュしてきた巨大なピ
ンク色の物体に力いっぱい跳ね飛ばされた。
dialogues.en: The rumbling started to get closer and louder, quickly.
dialogues.text: The rumbling started to get closer and louder, quickly.

dialogues.en: "Hold it!!"
dialogues.text: "Hold it!!"

dialogues.jp:
姿をしかと確認する間もなく、『そいつ』は地
響きをたてて廊下に消えていった。
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha! You think that can hold me down, my dear puppy!?
Laughable!"
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha! You think that can hold me down, my dear puppy!?
Laughable!"

dialogues.jp:
気の迷いか……女子の制服を着込んだ真ん丸い
クマであったような………………。
dialogues.en:
"In the name of Nemu-senpai and the God of bananas, I'd
definitely catch you!"
dialogues.text:
"In the name of Nemu-senpai and the God of bananas, I'd
definitely catch you!"

dialogues.jp:
煩悶のあまりついにあんな幻覚を見るようになっ
たのか……。
dialogues.en: *fwoosh!*
dialogues.text: *fwoosh!*

dialogues.jp: （……………………ぃやいやいやいやいや）
dialogues.en: "Waahhh!"
dialogues.text: "Waahhh!"

dialogues.jp: そんなものが実在する筈はないだろう。
dialogues.en:
Caught in the middle of the dispute between the Suginami and
Amakase factions, I was thrown to the floor in the frenzy.
dialogues.text:
Caught in the middle of the dispute between the Suginami and
Amakase factions, I was thrown to the floor in the frenzy.

dialogues.jp: しっかりしろ、正気を保て。
dialogues.en:
Suginami was probably trying to ferret out information from
the discplinary committee again.
dialogues.text:
Suginami was probably trying to ferret out information from
the discplinary committee again.

dialogues.jp: ぱちん、と頬をひとつ叩く。
dialogues.en:
In a way, he enjoys the inevitable chase after. A pretty
ominous sign for the future...
dialogues.text:
In a way, he enjoys the inevitable chase after. A pretty
ominous sign for the future...

dialogues.en: I started to get up, supporting myself with my hand.
dialogues.text: I started to get up, supporting myself with my hand.

dialogues.jp: その瞬間、指先に鈍い痛みが走った。

どうも突き飛ばされたとき手にヘンな力をかけ
てしまったようだ。
dialogues.en: As I tried to, I felt a dull pain in my fingertip.
dialogues.text: As I tried to, I felt a dull pain in my fingertip.

dialogues.jp: 「いててて……こりゃ突き指だな」
dialogues.en: I thought I felt something strange when I fell down...
dialogues.text: I thought I felt something strange when I fell down...

dialogues.jp:
動かそうとして力を入れると鈍い痛みがまたぞ
ろ指に走った。
dialogues.en: "Owww... I must've jammed it into the floor."
dialogues.text: "Owww... I must've jammed it into the floor."

dialogues.jp: ということは今のクマも幻覚ではなかったのか？
dialogues.en: Whenever I tried to move it, the same dull pain took over.
dialogues.text: Whenever I tried to move it, the same dull pain took over.

dialogues.jp:
（廊下を疾走するクマと、そんな幻を見る恋煩
　い男子学生……どっちがマシなんだろう）
dialogues.en: I kept it still, and headed for the infirmary.
dialogues.text: I kept it still, and headed for the infirmary.

dialogues.jp:
俺は痛む指をかばいながら、ひとまず保健室へ
と向かった。

dialogues.en: As I went, the end-of-recess bell rang.
dialogues.text: As I went, the end-of-recess bell rang.

dialogues.jp:
途中まで来たところで、昼休み終了を告げるチャ
イムが鳴り響いた。
dialogues.en: Oh well. I have an excuse at least, thanks to my finger.
dialogues.text: Oh well. I have an excuse at least, thanks to my finger.

dialogues.jp:
まあいい。授業が始まったとはいえ、俺には指
に手当てという正当な理由がある。
dialogues.en:
...And I'd take any chance I can get to avoid Kudou for as
long as I can.
dialogues.text:
...And I'd take any chance I can get to avoid Kudou for as
long as I can.

dialogues.jp:
……それに今の俺は一秒でも工藤と顔をあわせ
る時間を短縮したかった。
dialogues.en:
As I came to the front of the infirmary, I decided against
knocking to avoid more pain on my finger.
dialogues.text:
As I came to the front of the infirmary, I decided against
knocking to avoid more pain on my finger.

dialogues.jp:
保健室扉前、ノックをしようかとも思ったが何
より指が痛かった。
dialogues.en:
In any case, at this time, there won't be any students
inside anyway.
dialogues.text:
In any case, at this time, there won't be any students
inside anyway.

dialogues.jp:
まぁどうせ、この時間なら保健室にいるのはサ
ボリ学生ぐらいなものだろう。
dialogues.en: "Excuse m..."
dialogues.text: "Excuse m..."

dialogues.jp: 「失礼しま……」
dialogues.en: I called out as I stepped inside.
dialogues.text: I called out as I stepped inside.

dialogues.jp: 俺は声をかけると同時に中へと踏み込んだ。
dialogues.en: --*creak*
dialogues.text: --*creak*

dialogues.jp: 「キャアアァ！？」
――その途端、可憐な悲鳴があたりに響く。

dialogues.en:
My eyes were met with Yuki-sensei holding a stethoscope to
the chest of what looked like a female student...
dialogues.text:
My eyes were met with Yuki-sensei holding a stethoscope to
the chest of what looked like a female student...

dialogues.jp:
俺の目に飛び込んできたのは、聴診器を手にし
た保健教師と胸を｛くつろ／寛｝げた女子生徒の姿――
dialogues.en: "I, I'm sorr.."
dialogues.text: "I, I'm sorr.."

dialogues.en:
An apology flew out of my mouth isntantly, as something with
me started to swell.
dialogues.text:
An apology flew out of my mouth isntantly, as something with
me started to swell.

dialogues.jp:
｛とっさ／咄嗟｝に謝罪の言葉のようなものが口から飛び出
したが、それにも増して、よくわからない違和
感が肥大していく。

……それは確かに……俺のクラスメイト――工
藤叶だった。
dialogues.en: ...Indeed... that was my classmate, Kudou Kanae.
dialogues.text: ...Indeed... that was my classmate, Kudou Kanae.

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉君！？」
dialogues.en: "A, Asakura-kun!?"
dialogues.text: "A, Asakura-kun!?"

dialogues.jp:
ゆき先生が工藤の前に立ちはだかり俺の視線か
ら、工藤をガードする。
dialogues.en:
Yuki-sensei quickly stood in front of Kudou, covering her
from my sight.
dialogues.text:
Yuki-sensei quickly stood in front of Kudou, covering her
from my sight.

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どうかしたの？」
dialogues.en: "W, what's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "W, what's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、あの、突き指……」
dialogues.en:
"Leave it under cold water for awhile, then apply this and
don't move it."
dialogues.text:
"Leave it under cold water for awhile, then apply this and
don't move it."

dialogues.speaker: Yuki-sensei
dialogues.jp: 「水道の水で冷やしてからこれで固定して」
dialogues.en: "O, ok."
dialogues.text: "O, ok."

dialogues.jp:
しどろもどろになりつつ痛む指を見せると、ゆ
き先生はそれでも『にっこり』と笑って絆創膏
をひと巻き投げつけてくる。
dialogues.en: Scary...
dialogues.text: Scary...

dialogues.jp: 「は、はひっ」
dialogues.en: With such a heated atmosphere, I quickly left the infirmary.
dialogues.text: With such a heated atmosphere, I quickly left the infirmary.

dialogues.jp: こ、怖い。
dialogues.en: Then I leaned my back against the door.
dialogues.text: Then I leaned my back against the door.

dialogues.jp: その勢いに気圧され、俺は保健室を飛び出した。
その背中で乱暴にドアが閉められる。
dialogues.en: Um...
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.en:
I unreasonably tried to get my brain to fully comprehend the
scene I just saw.
dialogues.text:
I unreasonably tried to get my brain to fully comprehend the
scene I just saw.

dialogues.jp: えと……。
dialogues.en:
Hypothesis number 1. It was another person, with a striking
resemblance.
dialogues.text:
Hypothesis number 1. It was another person, with a striking
resemblance.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、頭を無理に働かせ、目にした光景の意味を
理解しようとつとめた。
dialogues.en:
Hypothesis number 2. A curse was placed on Kudou which
caused the expansion of the chest, and required immediate
consultation.
dialogues.text:
Hypothesis number 2. A curse was placed on Kudou which
caused the expansion of the chest, and required immediate
consultation.

dialogues.jp:
仮定その１。
単に容姿の似通った他人説。
dialogues.en: Hypothesis number 3. A conspiracy involving space aliens.
dialogues.text: Hypothesis number 3. A conspiracy involving space aliens.

dialogues.jp:
仮定その２。
胸の膨らむ呪いに悩まされている工藤がこっそ
り保健教師のもとへ相談に訪れていた説。
dialogues.en: "...What am I thinking about.
dialogues.text: "...What am I thinking about.

dialogues.jp:
仮定その３。
宇宙人の陰謀説。
dialogues.en:
Something like this doesn't work when there's only one
person to play the boke and tsukkomi roles.
dialogues.text:
Something like this doesn't work when there's only one
person to play the boke and tsukkomi roles.

dialogues.jp: 「……ってなんでやねん」
dialogues.en:
There's the most obvious answer for it, albeit the one that
my mind's finding hard to understand.
dialogues.text:
There's the most obvious answer for it, albeit the one that
my mind's finding hard to understand.

dialogues.jp:
一通り「ひとりノリツッコミ」を行ったあと、
俺はとうとう結論に達した。
dialogues.en: "Kudou's a.... g, girl?"
dialogues.text: "Kudou's a.... g, girl?"

dialogues.jp:
それは一番簡単ではっきりとした、しかも俺の
悩みまで一気に解決してくれる説明だ。
dialogues.en:
--Namely, looking like a guy, but actually a girl... for
some reason, disgusing herself as a guy.
dialogues.text:
--Namely, looking like a guy, but actually a girl... for
some reason, disgusing herself as a guy.

dialogues.jp:
――すなわち「彼」、工藤叶は本当は「彼女」
であり……なんらかの理由で男装している少女
であるということだ。
dialogues.en: There's probably an explanation for that.
dialogues.text: There's probably an explanation for that.

dialogues.jp: あまりにご都合的な解釈。
dialogues.en:
But both ways, forgetting about alien conspiracies, that's
the most likely reason.
dialogues.text:
But both ways, forgetting about alien conspiracies, that's
the most likely reason.

dialogues.jp:
だが、どんな宇宙人の陰謀説よりもそれが一番
しっくりとくる。
dialogues.en:
And so often, I thought his face looked female. Apparently
it was...
dialogues.text:
And so often, I thought his face looked female. Apparently
it was...

dialogues.jp: 「はっ、ははっ、あはははは………」
dialogues.en: "Ha, haha, ahahahahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Ha, haha, ahahahahahaha..."

dialogues.jp:
何故、どんな事情で――なんてことを考えるよ
り先に、俺はひとりでに笑い出していた。
dialogues.en:
I could put away all the circusmtances first-- as I thought
about it, I started smiling to myself.
dialogues.text:
I could put away all the circusmtances first-- as I thought
about it, I started smiling to myself.

dialogues.jp:
そう、工藤が女の子であるのなら、俺はこの感
情にストップをかけることもない。
dialogues.en:
Yes, now that I know Kudou's a girl, there's no need for me
to keep these feelings to myself.
dialogues.text:
Yes, now that I know Kudou's a girl, there's no need for me
to keep these feelings to myself.

dialogues.jp:
ああ認めよう！　認めてやるさ！　俺は工藤叶
が大好きだ！！
dialogues.en: I can accept it now! I really like Kudou Kanae!
dialogues.text: I can accept it now! I really like Kudou Kanae!

dialogues.jp: 「…………ぅおし！！　胸を張れ恋心！」
dialogues.en: ".....Alright! This is the awakening of my love!"
dialogues.text: ".....Alright! This is the awakening of my love!"

dialogues.jp:
人、一人通らない授業中の廊下で、俺は大きく
ガッツポーズをとったのだった。
dialogues.en: In the middle of the deserted hallway, I made a guts pose.
dialogues.text: In the middle of the deserted hallway, I made a guts pose.

dialogues.jp: ◆恋心全開◆
dialogues.en: ◆Complete Love Awakening◆
dialogues.text: ◆Complete Love Awakening◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりのアドバイスのおかげで、自分としては、
その気持ちを受け入れる事ができた。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to Kotori's advice, I started acceping my feelings
bit by bit.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to Kotori's advice, I started acceping my feelings
bit by bit.

dialogues.jp:
が、そんな事、とても人に言えるわけもなく今
日も今日とて｛もんもん／悶々｝とした日々……。
dialogues.en:
But even that didn't stop me from worrying endlessly daya
fter day...
dialogues.text:
But even that didn't stop me from worrying endlessly daya
fter day...

dialogues.jp:
悩みすぎてとうとう幻覚が見えるようになった
俺は、ピンクのクマに跳ね飛ばされ、指を負傷
してしまう。
dialogues.en:
As I was strolling in deep thought, a chase between Miharu
and Suginami led to me injuring my finger.
dialogues.text:
As I was strolling in deep thought, a chase between Miharu
and Suginami led to me injuring my finger.

dialogues.jp:
仕方なく向かった保健室で偶然、工藤が実は女
であるということを知った俺。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to my trip to the infiramary after, I foudn out that
Kudou was really a woman.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to my trip to the infiramary after, I foudn out that
Kudou was really a woman.

dialogues.jp:
今までの悩みが一気に晴れた俺は、廊下で一人、
大きくガッツポーズを取ったのだった。
dialogues.en:
Now with my mind perfectly clear, I made a large guts pose
in the empty hallway.
dialogues.text:
Now with my mind perfectly clear, I made a large guts pose
in the empty hallway.
